name: Alice no Yakata 3
source:
A collection of five mini-games with Alice from the Rance series. 
The first two games in this series were only available on Japanese computers. It includes a quiz game "TokuSakari quiz Rerorero", fighting Prince Patton, a female teacher in agony hell visual novel with two endings - one good and a darker one. 

[From [url=http://www.legendsworld.net/adventure/year/1995#16910]legendsworld[/url]]
translation:
本作由5款以《兰斯》系列吉祥物爱丽丝为主角的小游戏组成。
《爱丽丝之馆》系列前两作只在日本电脑平台发行。本作收录了问答游戏《特盛问答舔不停》、与巴顿王子交手的格斗游戏，以及视觉小说《女教师闷绝地狱》。最后一款游戏有两个结局，一个圆满，另一个则更加黑暗。

[引自[url=http://www.legendsworld.net/adventure/year/1995#16910]legendsworld[/url]]
